name: Webbing
description: The web — the thin panel between the ribs, cut away here so only the frame is left.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @shape(points: 3; rotate: @pick(0, 180); scale: 0.98; frame: @pick(10, 18)); clip-path: @shape(points: 3; rotate: @pick(0, 180); scale: 0.98; frame: @pick(10, 18)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
